The '''Susskind–Glogower operator''', first proposed by [[Leonard Susskind]] and Jonathan Glogower,<ref>{{cite journal | last1 = Susskind | first1 = L. | last2 = Glogower | first2 = J. | year = 1964 | title = Quantum mechanical phase and time operator | journal = Physica | volume = 1 | page = 49 | url = https://books.google.com/books?id=c3JDAQAAIAAJ }}</ref> refers to the operator where the phase is introduced as an approximate polar decomposition of the [[creation and annihilation operators]].

It is defined as

: <math> V=\frac{1}{\sqrt{aa^{\dagger}}}a</math>,
and its adjoint
: <math> V^{\dagger}=a^{\dagger}\frac{1}{\sqrt{aa^{\dagger}}}</math>.

Their [[commutation relation]] is

: <math> [V,V^{\dagger}]=|0\rangle\langle 0|</math>,

where  <math> |0\rangle</math> is the vacuum state of the [[harmonic oscillator]].

They may be regarded as a (exponential of) [[phase operator]] because

: <math>Va^{\dagger}a V^{\dagger}=a^{\dagger}a+1</math>,

where <math>a^{\dagger}a</math> is the number operator. So the exponential of the phase operator displaces the [[number operator]] in the same fashion as the [[momentum operator]] acts as the generator of [[Translation_operator_(quantum_mechanics)|translations in quantum mechanics]]: 
<math>\exp\left(i\frac{\hat{p}x_o}{\hbar}\right)\hat{x}\exp\left(-i\frac{\hat{p}x_o}{\hbar}\right)=\hat{x}+x_0</math>.

They may be used to solve problems such as atom-field interactions,<ref>{{cite journal | last1 = Rodríguez-Lara | first1 = B. M. | last2 = Moya-Cessa | first2 = H.M. | year = 2013 | title = Exact solution of generalized Dicke models via Susskind-Glogower operators | doi = 10.1088/1751-8113/46/9/095301 | journal = Journal of Physics A | volume = 46 | issue = 9| article-number = 095301 | arxiv = 1207.6551 | bibcode = 2013JPhA...46i5301R | s2cid = 118671292 }}</ref> level-crossings  <ref>{{cite journal | last1 = Rodríguez-Lara | first1 = B.M. | last2 = Rodríguez-Méndez | first2 = D. | last3 = Moya-Cessa | first3 = H. | year = 2011 | title = Solution to the Landau-Zener problem via Susskind-Glogower operators | doi = 10.1016/j.physleta.2011.08.051 | journal = Physics Letters A | volume = 375 | issue = 43| pages = 3770–3774 | arxiv = 1105.4013 | bibcode = 2011PhLA..375.3770R | s2cid = 118486579 }}</ref> or to define some class of [[non-linear coherent states]],<ref>{{cite journal | last1 = León-Montiel | first1 = J. | last2 = Moya-Cessa | first2 = H. | last3 = Soto-Eguibar | first3 = F. | year = 2011 | title = Nonlinear coherent states for the Susskind-Glogower operators | url = http://rmf.smf.mx/pdf/rmf-s/57/3/57_3_133.pdf | journal = Revista Mexicana de Física | volume = 57 | page = 133 | arxiv = 1303.2516 }}</ref> among others.
